correctness.rationale: The cited manifold theorem at d=2 and connectivity theorem at (m,d)=(6,2) apply to the ordered complex. Euler characteristic 42 gives b₂=40 by simple connectivity and Poincaré duality. The signed top chain is a cycle and a label transposition multiplies it by −1, including the two local vertex-reordering signs. This forces signature zero. The product Alexander–Whitney formula in the record uses the correct three degree splits and evaluation of cup squares is additive on cohomology in characteristic two. An independent staircase triangulation with 840 top simplices checks the integral top-cycle boundary and evaluates ordinary simplicial cup squares on a full 419-element basis of the degree-two cocycle space; all evaluations are zero. Thus the integral unimodular lattice is even; its rank and signature identify it with H^{⊕20}. Wu's formula and mod-two Poincaré duality give w₂=0. Both manifolds have trivial Kirby–Siebenmann obstruction, so topological classification applies. The orientation may be chosen compatibly, or adjusted using the orientation-reversing transposition.
residual_risks: The conclusion is oriented topological homeomorphism, not PL, smooth or equivariant classification.
